scripts.lint:py: npm run lint:py:ruff && npm run lint:py:dupes
scripts.lint:py:ruff: cd backend && poetry run ruff check src/ tests/
scripts.lint:py:dupes: cd backend && poetry run pylint --rcfile=.pylintrc src/ tests/
scripts.test:e2e: cd backend && poetry run pytest tests/e2e/ -v
scripts.test:e2e:quick: cd backend && poetry run pytest tests/e2e/ -q
